notes.title: Closed Beta Test has begun
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]The closed beta test has begun! In it we are testing the features we have planned for the first Early Access release. There's still a few spots open, so if you want to help us test the game, drop by our Discord and let us know. [url="https://discord.gg/qy9xe35hXh" style="button"]Join the Vanguard Galaxy Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Before we go, we want to share a little preview of what's to come. For example this overview of the map with a whole bunch of sectors to explore.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600949/50c4da79cea62438960418adcbe61ccfacf4a9a8.png"][/img][/p][p]Each of these sectors consists of systems, which can be closed off pockets with interesting things to discover or regular systems with representation of some of the different factions.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600949/40ea042ec89f85b97ae9d6637966528cb4eec251.png"][/img][/p][p]Like this one[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600949/ff0aac16771d681bf03061f0e5d99230120031fd.png"][/img][/p][p]In these systems you can fight your enemies[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600949/9763ffdee4b7a7f2af0525dc45c462267b0d3010.png"][/img][/p][p]And loot their remains[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600949/c947e689c7c46ecf5b023fe0604509ff0fa0cd90.png"][/img][/p][p]Or relax and blow up some asteroids for valuable ores[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600949/134fc5910fd88bfec4d184dfda9c90e89ec2b259.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can loot, craft and discover many different modules and equipment with potentially very powerful effects. Allowing you to create a build suited to the role of your ship.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600949/0729a67955c61f3651819ed4179bdf226a2bd740.png"][/img][/p][p]And test your latest combat build against waves of enemies to get even better loot.[/p][p][/p][p]All this and more is coming soon to Early Access.[/p][p]We hope to see you there[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Bad Roost Games[/p]

notes.title: Our plans for Vanguard Galaxy
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]First of all we want to thank everyone that played our demo and those that gave us feedback about the game. And with Next Fest behind us we want to let you know what our plans are for Vanguard Galaxy. [/p][p][/p][p]Drumroll.... :)[/p][p][/p][p]We plan to release the game in Early Access this Autumn. [/p][p]It will at least include the following[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]A procedural galaxy with at least 100 systems to explore[/p][/*][*][p]Infinite scaling content focused on combat: venture into dangerous portals to find better loot[/p][/*][*][p]A much improved galaxy map that will allow you to navigate (to) these systems[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of variety in activities you can find in the galaxy[/p][/*][*][p]Dozens of ships to discover and obtain[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded crafting possibilities[/p][/*][*][p]Up to 9 skill trees [/p][/*][*][p]Improved itemization, rarities of all types[/p][/*][*][p]Market mechanics that allow trading of commodities[/p][/*][*][p]Stats overview of what your current loadout can do[/p][/*][*][p]More variety in weapons to use for all activities[/p][/*][*][p]Hazardous environments that will require you to improve your ships resistances[/p][/*][*][p]Improved autopilot behavior that handles all activities equally well[/p][/*][*][p]Act 1 of the story[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]And of course next to all this we will keep on improving the overall game experience.[/p][p][/p][p]We also plan to run a closed beta test before the Early Access release, so if you are interested in testing out the game before hand, let us know on discord. [/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Bad Roost Games[/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest and Demo Update 5.5.0
notes.content: [p]Hey all, [/p][p][/p][p]Tonight Steam Next Fest will kick off and we're taking part with our demo. [/p][p]Tell your friends and we hope you enjoy the demo.[/p][p][/p][p]Changes:[/p][list][*][p]Added some more sound effects [/p][/*][*][p]New explosion effect [/p][/*][*][p]NPC's now jump into and out of points of interest[/p][/*][*][p]Pirate miners at "Reclaim Asteroid Belt" missions can be chased off[/p][/*][*][p]Added a miner with Core Explosive Launcher to the "Reclaim Asteroid Belt" mission[/p][/*][*][p]Movement marker added when you give a move command [/p][/*][*][p]Added Health bars for damaged units[/p][/*][*][p]Added target indicator for your currently selected target[/p][/*][*][p]The Autopilot will pick up salvage items for salvage missions [/p][/*][*][p]Added hotkey overview in settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added check for ammo while in a combat point of interest with the autopilot engaged, if empty the autopilot will return to the space station, it does not automatically stock up (yet)[/p][/*][/list][p] Bugfixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed getting a jump gate pass twice during combat playthrough [/p][/*][*][p]Hint added to "Recover the materials" mission[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for the tractor beam holding on to a target while cargo hold is full[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for having multiple salvage missions for the same item at once[/p][/*][*][p]The "Reclaim Asteroid Belt" mission is now seen as a combat mission for the autopilot[/p][/*][/list][p]And some smaller tweaks such as textual changes.  [/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy the demo, and enjoy Steam Next Fest[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers, [/p][p]Bad Roost Games[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 5.4.0 - Combat start
notes.content:
Hey all,

Today's update brings a new starting option to the demo, which is Combat. 
It includes a brand new starter ship as well, the Margil, adds its own skill tree and a different path to finish the demo. 

Changes:
[list]
[*] Combat start as an option for New Game
[*] Margil is now available as a starter ship
[*] Skill tree for combat
[*] New missions
[*] New path to finish the demo
[*] Fullscreen toggle added in menu's
[*] Added buyback to shops for when you accidentally sell something important
[*] Stack manipulation added so you can organize your inventory more easily
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] The Gatling gun performance has been improved
[*] Improved transparency, some assets would still allow you to see through or click through the game
[*] Chunks falling of ships would sometimes move in a funny way, no more, we don't like funny
[*] The Galaxy map would break when you still had completed missions open
[*] Material storage now correctly works when selecting the "Material Storage Boost" skill
[/list]

And some smaller tweaks.

Enjoy the demo and tell us what you think. And let us know if you like the new combat start.

Cheers,

Bad Roost Games

notes.title: Demo update 0.5.3 encore
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We just pushed a hotfix for our recent update.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Transparency option added that is enabled by default. It works well with the Steam overlay. The old transparency option is available as Performant.
[*] Added an option to move the transparent window, so its now possible to stick it to the top of your window if you like. :)
[*] Starting credits increased
[/list]
Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Fix for camera losing track of spaceship when the game loses focus
[*] Fix for docking after combat, the spaceship sometimes kept moving
[*] Fix for teleporting of items to your cargo if they were completed in another spacestation
[*] Improved NPC behavior
[/list]
And a bunch of small tweaks.

Enjoy the demo and tell us what you think.

Cheers,

Bad Roost Games

notes.title: Demo update 0.5.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We just pushed a small update to our demo version of the game.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Added basic Steam Deck support
[*] Added fullscreen experimental option. For those that were wishing to play this game fullscreen on their second monitor, now you can!
[*] Added one new combat ship available for purchase
[*] Added two new spaceships for ambient spaceship captains
[*] Added reactor and energy management to equipment
[*] Improved combat look and feel, reduced combat difficulty
[*] Small UI look and feel improvements
[*] Added autocannon sound
[/list]
Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Fix for spaceship getting stuck in front of jumpgates
[*] Fix for loading the savegame after finishing the demo
[*] Better behavior for the steamoverlay in combination with transparency
[/list]
And various other small improvements.

Have fun playing the demo and let us know what you think.

Cheers,

Bad Roost Games
